title: Initial Canine Success Assessment
description: A 60-minute in-home assessment, and the starting point for adult behaviour, obedience, walking and adventure clients. Tristan talks through what you want to achieve, gets to know your dog's temperament and starts working with them to see how they respond, then recommends a program. You don't need to choose a program before you meet. Mobile service within 15km of Boondall, North Brisbane, with a travel fee beyond 10km. Puppy programs can be booked directly, with no assessment required.

title: The Foundation Program (1 week)
description: A one-week dog training program with 4 trainer-led sessions (In-Home Day Train or Walk and Train) followed by 1 one-on-one coaching session with you. The sessions can go toward obedience, foundation skills, behaviour work or fulfilment, and the training plan starts with the problems you most want solved. Includes feedback and video updates, plus the free guide 'The Four Building Blocks of a Balanced Dog'. New adult-dog clients start with the $120 Initial Canine Success Assessment.

title: The Connected Companion (3 weeks)
description: A three-week program of 15 sessions, with 4 trainer-led sessions and 1 coaching session each week. Your dog is trained at home and out on walks, building a communication system and skills that hold up around everyday distractions. It is for common behaviour problems and mild to moderate reactivity, and the weekly coaching passes the skills on to you. Includes feedback and video updates, plus the free guide 'The Four Building Blocks of a Balanced Dog'. New adult-dog clients start with the $120 Initial Canine Success Assessment.

title: The Balanced Canine (6 weeks)
description: A six-week program for severe or long-standing reactivity, multiple triggers, anxiety and aggression. It runs as 30 sessions, with 4 trainer-led sessions and 1 coaching session each week, and works on what is driving the behaviour, with time to change how your dog feels as well as what they do. It covers clear communication, practical handling for calmer walks, and impulse-control and counter-conditioning work matched to your dog's triggers. Includes ongoing support, feedback and videos, plus the free guide 'The Four Building Blocks of a Balanced Dog'. New adult-dog clients start with the $120 Initial Canine Success Assessment.

title: The Focused Progress Plan (5 coaching sessions)
description: Five private one-on-one coaching sessions you can use for any behaviour or skill, built around your goals and your dog. You learn the training methods that work for your dog, and how clarity, connection and play fit into their training, with support from Tristan between sessions. Sessions expire 6 months after purchase. Includes the free guide 'The Four Building Blocks of a Balanced Dog'.

title: One-on-One Private Coaching (60 minutes)
description: One private 60-minute coaching session in your home or at a public place that suits your goal. Tristan coaches you as the handler, with techniques tailored to your dog and practical work on the behaviour or skill that matters most, so you can keep using it after the session.

title: Virtual Coaching and Support (60-minute video call)
description: A private one-hour video call for owners outside the in-person service area, or anyone who wants ongoing guidance without the travel time. Use it to fine-tune training details, work through something that feels stuck, review footage or build a practical training plan. This is a coaching session, separate from the Initial Assessment.

title: The Confident Start Program (puppy, 6 in-home sessions)
description: A puppy program of 6 private in-home coaching sessions for you, your family and your puppy, booked directly with no assessment needed. It covers house training guidance and setup, socialisation and desensitisation guidance with a checklist, and the five foundational manners: sit, stay, come, place and loose-lead walking foundations. Includes a toilet training tracker and a free 50+ page puppy raising guide. Sessions expire 3 months after purchase. Based in Boondall, serving North Brisbane.

title: The Real World Reliability Package (5 Walk and Train sessions)
description: Five trainer-led 30-minute Walk and Train sessions, with home pickup included. Obedience, manners and loose-lead walking are practised on everyday walks around traffic, people, dogs and other distractions. Sessions expire 6 months after purchase. Includes the free guide 'The Four Building Blocks of a Balanced Dog'. New adult-dog clients start with the $120 Initial Canine Success Assessment.

title: The Adventure Pack (5 adventure outings)
description: Five one-hour adventure outings with training built in, and home pickup included. Each outing mixes exploration, play and exercise suited to your dog with recall and impulse-control practice around distractions, followed by a video and feedback with tips for you. Sessions expire 6 months after purchase. Includes the free guide 'The Four Building Blocks of a Balanced Dog'. New adult-dog clients start with the $120 Initial Canine Success Assessment.

title: Walk and Train (30 minutes)
description: One trainer-led 30-minute session. Tristan collects your dog from home and trains locally on the behaviours you choose, using the streets and distractions around your home, so skills practised indoors carry into outdoor settings. Training tools and treats are included.

title: Adventure Walk and Training (60 minutes)
description: One trainer-led 60-minute outing at a local forest, park or beach chosen to suit your dog, with collection from home. There is time for sniffing and exploration, play and exercise matched to your dog, and obedience practice around everyday distractions, plus a video update afterwards. Training tools and treats are included.
